input.command:
python3 -c '
# Let us separate table and pot in obs 74:
import cv2, numpy as np
img = cv2.imread("/work/observations/obs_0074.png")

# Pot is terracotta orange-brown: R > 150, G < 100, B < 60
mask_pot = (img[:,:,2] > 150) & (img[:,:,1] < 100) & (img[:,:,0] < 60)
yp, xp = np.where(mask_pot)
print(f"Pot 2: x=[{xp.min()}, {xp.max()}], y=[{yp.min()}, {yp.max()}], center_x={xp.mean():.1f}")

# Table is dark brown: R ~ 100-140, G ~ 50-80, B ~ 10-40
mask_table = (img[:,:,2] > 90) & (img[:,:,2] < 150) & (img[:,:,1] > 40) & (img[:,:,1] < 80) & (img[:,:,0] < 40)
yt, xt = np.where(mask_table)
print(f"Table: x=[{xt.min()}, {xt.max()}], y=[{yt.min()}, {yt.max()}]")
'
